dedupe_keys.name: a 100 m gridded population dataset of china s seventh census using ensemble learning and geospatial big data

description: The China 2020 population-grid research team publishes a 100 m population estimate based on the seventh national census. County and town counts are combined with ten spatial covariates through a stacking ensemble using random forest, XGBoost and LightGBM base models. Figshare provides the PopSE China 2020 package as a public RAR archive under CC-BY-4.0, free to reuse with attribution. The repository reports better town-level agreement than its selected comparison products, but that assessment was not reproduced. Internal raster encoding was not confirmed from the compressed package. A limitation is that downscaled census counts are estimates of residential distribution, not direct observations in every cell. The grid could supply population exposure or service-demand weights for infrastructure simulations at suitable scales. It complements the official census totals with a finer spatial allocation and should be checked for aggregate consistency before use.
